callees.name: _next_message
callees.pre_condition: deadline is a monotonic timestamp in the future. self has an active connection to the ELP server.
callees.post_condition: Returns the next complete JSON-RPC message from the server as a dict. Blocks until a message arrives or the deadline is reached. Raises an exception when the deadline expires before a message is received or when the connection to the server is lost.

callees.name: _handle_server_message
callees.pre_condition: message is a dict representing a JSON-RPC message from the server that is not the response to the current request (either a server notification or a response for a different request_id).
callees.post_condition: Processes the server message according to its type and content. Does not return a value relevant to the caller.
